{{Club Brugge KV sections}}

'''Club NXT''' is the [[Youth system|youth academy]] of Belgian [[Association football|football]] club [[Club Brugge KV|Club Brugge]]. The most senior team of Club NXT acts as Club Brugge's reserve team, and competes in the [[Challenger Pro League]], the second flight of [[Football in Belgium|Belgian football]]."}}
